about_the_game:
Battle Train DLC: Revenge of the Puffin is pulling into the station—are you ready for the ride?

Step into a frosty new battlefield with Ludwig the Buffin, a brand-new Champion with a beak full of vengeance and feathers full of fury. This action-packed DLC delivers a fresh narrative experience, explosive new content, and icy-cool challenges that will test your tactical mettle.

What's Included:
・A new story arc revealing Aalvado’s shady origins, complete with fully voice acted and animated cutscenes!
・A new NON-Roguelite Campaign stuffed with over 27 handcrafted puzzles, fights, and challenges to test your track laying skills.
・A slew of new content, including cards, train parts, ornaments, hats, stickers, and some brand new opponents
・The ability to play as some of your favorite characters in special combat scenarios!
